note: Training uses repeated contextual scenarios, including fetch during feeding time. Rewards combine graded context fit, drive relief, successful task completion, effort, and satisfaction-weighted disappointment; non-compliance alone is not treated as automatically wrong. Stimulus alignment is a synthetic engineering diagnostic, not perceived believability.
stimulus_alignment_note: Heuristic engineering diagnostic for broad stimulus/action compatibility only; not a validated animal-behaviour model or measure of perceived believability.
